alex r: quick heads-up — ran the compact-kernel switchbench on the 8xA100 pool overnight, numbers look promising.
priya: summary pls — p50/p95/cost? :eyes:
alex r: short summary: switched to compact-kernel (tiled QKV + int8-friendly reductions). workload = mixed chat+completion (avg seq 384). canary 5% on canary-hostpool-4.
alex r: results (canary vs baseline): p50 28ms -> 24ms (-14%); p95 112ms -> 92ms (-17.9%); GPU mem 24.8GB -> 20.1GB (-19%); throughput +12%; est infra cost/token -11.5%.
maria: ran prompt-regressions v2? any quality regressions?
alex r: ran 2k prompts, 6 flagged for tiny sampling shifts, HITL reviewed, nothing actionable.
jon: rollout plan and kill switches?
alex r: rollout: 5% for 24h -> 25% for 6h -> full over 12h. kill switches: runtime.config.compact_kernel.enabled and runtime.config.compact_kernel.per_model_overrides.
alex r: alerts to watch: infra.alerts.latency.p95 (baseline +10%), infra.alerts.error.rate.model_mismatch (>0.01%), hostpool.memory_pressure, fallback_kernel_invocations metric.
ops-bot: deploy event: canary rollout initiated by alex r on canary-hostpool-4 (5% traffic). link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/rollouts/1800123456
jon: canary hosts? need to hook SRE dashboard.
alex r: hosts rh-c4-07, rh-c4-09, rh-c4-11. uploaded nvidia-smi snapshots to artifacts.
maria: short sequences (<64) perf?
alex r: microbench shows <64 seq sees ~1-3% p50 regression due to packing overhead; default per-model guard disables compact for seq<96.
oncall: acknowledged — monitoring p95, mem pressure, fallback metrics; will report in 6h.
priya: add perf summary to runtime runbook and canary dashboard, then i can sign off if alerts stay green.
alex r: will add graphs + perf writeup, PR with kernel code + canary logs incoming to eng-runtime in ~30m. if green we save ~12% infra cost and free capacity for extra QPS. :rocket:
